semantics.definition: The rules every Eidos motion curve must meet.
semantics.responsibility: Keep motion calm: a curve whose control points stay between its start and its end, so nothing bounces or overshoots.

bezier.description: The two control points of a cubic Bézier curve, x1, y1, x2, y2, each from 0 to 1, as CSS cubic-bezier() takes them.
